# Get paid

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Payments
- What: Take money through a payment provider, so card details never touch your app.
- Applies when: the app takes payments.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Card details go straight to the payment provider, and the app never receives or stores a card number. A test-mode payment completes end to end.

### Webhook fulfilment
- What: Grant what was bought only when the payment provider confirms the payment.
- Applies when: the app takes payments.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Access is granted when the provider's signed webhook arrives, not when the browser returns. A fake webhook is refused, and a repeated one grants once.

### Subscriptions
- What: Charge on a schedule, and give or remove access as the subscription changes.
- Applies when: the app sells subscriptions.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Subscribing, renewing, cancelling and expiry each change the user's access correctly, driven by the provider's events in test mode.

### Failed payments
- What: Handle a renewal that does not go through: tell the user, wait, then remove access.
- Applies when: the app sells subscriptions.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A failed renewal marks the account as past due, tells the user, and removes access after the grace period.

### Money as cents
- What: Store amounts as whole numbers of the smallest unit, such as cents, to avoid rounding errors.
- Applies when: the app stores or calculates money.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Amounts are stored and calculated as whole numbers of the smallest unit, such as cents. A test adds 10 cents and 20 cents and gets exactly 30, and a total over many items has no rounding drift.
